text:
maria: Quick heads-up — API doc mismatch in /generate examples. cURL snippets omit Content-Type and fail for some clients. Filed docs PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/789

alex: thanks! can you paste the failing curl? I can try locally

maria: repro:
```bash
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"redwood/1","input":"hi"}'
```
This returns 415 from runtime — needs `-H "Content-Type: application/json"` for non-SSE. For SSE examples we should use `Accept: text/event-stream` and `Content-Type: application/json`.

jas: ugh, so docs show `curl --data` but not the header. I'll review PR. Also cross-link in SDK snippets where we show `requests.post` example.

kevin: runtime note: endpoint will accept `application/json` only; previously accepted form-data during migration, but we removed fallback. we should mention migration guide for users who relied on implicit defaults.

maria: propose: update cURL examples to include Content-Type, add a short note about SSE vs non-SSE, and add a one-line migration tip. PR has updated curl + py snippet but not ruby. @jas can you add ruby? :pray:

jas: on it, will add ruby and node snippets. Will also change header in streaming examples to `Accept: text/event-stream` and add small example of handling SSE in node:
```js
const res = await fetch(url, {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: {
    'Authorization': `Bearer ${KEY}`,
    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    'Accept': 'text/event-stream'
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({model: 'redwood/1', input: 'hi'})
});
// handle SSE lines...
```

docs-bot: Link check failed for https://docs.redwood.ai/reference/generate -> 404 (in /docs/old-generate). Created issue #102 in docs repo.

alex: if link changed, add redirect note and update TOC. Also we should add a small test in CI that fetches examples via curl to ensure header present.

kevin: agree. I'll add a lint rule to docs CI: flag curl blocks that POST/PUT without `Content-Type` header.

maria: sweet, leaving PR open for edits. Tagging release for docs patch v0.12.1. Thanks all :thumbsup:

kevin: deploying docs site after merge — will ping when live.

deploy-bot: Deploy started for docs-staging at https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/ — build 782

kevin: docs staging is up, spot-checked generate page, looks good. Closing loop.

maria: thanks everyone, will merge and backfill migration guide entry.
